description: LEJGUE crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C51 H50 Cl3 Dy3 N6 O21,C1 H4 O1. From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 6 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 6 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with approximately linear metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.690-3.709 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 102.08-106.43°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C52H54Cl3Dy3N6O22.
